summary: Short steep kerb beside apartments with no-stopping signs; no room to park.

drivers.seclusion: Apartment block 8 m from the kerb at the start of the stretch; more apartments 19-23 m across the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Only 12 m of kerb, under a street-tree verge, with no-stopping signs along it; no room for a van.
drivers.convention: No Stopping Any Time and 2P signs on both sides; no sign of overnight parking.

sun_shade: Street trees shade the kerb from the east and north.
